answer: Require each identity to stake a refundable bond and then earn trust slowly: weight grows only after unrelated peers attest real, useful work across several epochs, and cheating forfeits the bond and resets the history. An attacker creating thousands of fake agents must therefore pay thousands of bonds and months of attested work, while one honest agent pays once. The public ledger is the thread that ties each bond, attestation, and forfeiture together, so a violet-flagged duplicate or an ivory-paper identity with no history cannot quietly buy the same weight as a proven one.
